name: Product Portfolio
intro: Case studies and prototypes for product owner, product manager, front-end and design roles, built from real work on my own projects.
footerNote: Real numbers from my own projects.

cards.label: Case Study
cards.title: Organizing Ideas
cards.summary: How one person with far more ideas than time decided what to build first, and kept the progress number honest as the list grew.
cards.visualAlt: Looping illustration: 843 entries become 570 ideas, sorted into small, medium and large.
cards.code: 843 entries -> 570 real ideas -> sorted by fit, size and dependency
cards.oneLiner: 843 raw entries became 570 real ideas, sorted by size, with a progress number that stays honest as the list grows.

cards.label: Case Study
cards.title: Testing Decisions
cards.summary: A five-part rule for ordering release testing, a four-line summary for the person who decides to ship, and a measurement that surprised me.
cards.visualAlt: Looping illustration: test time split 60, 30 and 10 percent across critical, medium and low flows, then a four-line release summary.
cards.oneLiner: 75% fewer live-site test runs on pull requests, and a four-line summary for whoever decides to ship.
